COMPLICATIONS OF POLIOMYELITIS
- Multiple intestinal erosions
- Acute gastric dilatation
- Hypertension
- Hypercalcaemia
- Nephrocalcinosis
- Vascular lesions
- Myocarditis
- Pulmonary oedema and Pulmonary embolism
- Paralysis of limbs
- Muscles of respiration and swallowing which can be fatal
